overview.title: Money in plain sight
overview.intro: Review lesson charges, authorize secure card payments, and keep every invoice, receipt, and refund in one traceable record.
overview.secureBody: Card details go directly to Stripe. This application keeps references and the last four digits only—never a card number.

invoices.title: Invoices and receipts
invoices.empty: No invoices have been issued for this billing account.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.empty: No payment transactions have been recorded.

checkout.secureFields: Secure card payment fields hosted by Stripe
checkout.authorized: Authorization received. The charge will settle through the reconciliation flow.
checkout.hosted: Card fields above are rendered and processed by Stripe. They are not sent to or stored by 2tor.

errors.load: Stripe’s secure form could not load. Check the connection and try again.
errors.unavailable: Card payments are not configured for this environment.
errors.prepare: This payment could not be prepared. Refresh the invoice and try again.
errors.confirm: Stripe could not authorize this payment.

refunds.reasonPlaceholder: Record the policy or operational reason
refunds.error: The refund request was not accepted. Check the amount, permission, and MFA state.

discounts.title: Create a discount
discounts.intro: Sibling, referral, promotional, and manual discounts remain inactive unless an administrator creates or enables them.
discounts.error: The discount could not be created. Use a unique code and a percentage from 0.01 to 100.
